description: Keep an eye on your personal Linux VPS without installing a monitoring stack. See CPU, RAM, root disk and inode usage with absolute capacities and compact history charts. Read system counters over SSH or import an existing collector history without running duplicate measurements; the optional collector caps VPS history at 32 MiB. Requires SSH key access to Linux; optional background collection requires a separate Python 3 and Docker systemd setup, with no paid service or external API.
